top_signals.title: US officials work with CrowdStrike to fight malware behind crypto theft
top_signals.summary: Federal authorities and private-sector partners were part of an operation to disrupt malware that redirected about $150,000 in crypto over the last eight years.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Hyperscale Data shares hit all-time low as company flips Michigan site from bitcoin mining into AI
top_signals.summary: The Michigan AI agreement could generate more than $1.2 billion, with expansion options potentially lifting that above $3 billion.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: ‘Much ado about nothing’: CFTC files to dismiss CME’s lawsuit over crypto perpetual futures
top_signals.summary: The CFTC said CME lacks standing on its competitive-injury claims, as the exchange is free to list perp futures as a DCM.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Tech pilgrims flock to China as global innovation race heats up
top_signals.summary: Investors and entrepreneurs are paying thousands of dollars for rare access to Chinese factories, seeking a front-row seat to what could be the next technological revolution.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: £74m for branded condoms? UK must stop spaffing cash on foreign aid
top_signals.summary: Labour is plotting to reverse cuts to foreign aid, but the UK's spending history reveals a questionable use of funds, writes Anne Strickland.
